drafted_from: tool:transcribe-file (tools/audio-transcription/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json) and transcribeAFile in read-data/transcribe-a-file.mjs; it replaces the account-action of keep-and-wake-ai-sessions records/workshop-account-tool-records.json:222
start_here: Say to your AI: "Transcribe the recording clip.m4a from my files, in English." It runs tool:transcribe-file on it and gives back the timed words.
no_lists_because: It keeps nothing: the recording comes from the person's files and the transcript comes back in the answer (tool:keep-transcript keeps it when asked).
instructions: 1. Give the recording's name or identity in the person's files, the language when known, and the granted Python with mlx_whisper (program).
2. Call tool:transcribe-file with them; it hears the recording on this computer with the MLX Whisper model.
3. Read the answer: text is the whole transcript, segments hold each passage's start and end, and each word has its own start and end in seconds.

worked_examples.title: A recording in my files is transcribed into timed words
worked_examples.ask: Transcribe clip.m4a from my files, in English.
worked_examples.given: A recording named clip.m4a in the person's files, spoken in English.
worked_examples.hands_back: text, segments with their words, language en, heard_whole true, produced_by mlx_whisper. Nothing is written; the person's file is unchanged.
